sources.title: Bidoof — Sword & Shield Crown Zenith 111/159（Ability: Carefree Countenance）
sources.documentVersion: Card text as printed (Limitless card page); cross-checked against the Rainier card database 2026-10-09
sources.supportsZh: “As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.”：在备战区时，任何招式（双方的招式都算）对它造成的伤害都被防止；在战斗位时不生效。

sources.title: Rayquaza — XY Black Star Promos XY64（Ability: Ozone Wall）
sources.documentVersion: Official international card database; English card text cross-checked against the Rainier card database 2026-10-09 (pokemon.com page not read automatically)
sources.supportsZh: 同一特性写明 “(both yours and your opponent's)”，确认“招式”包括自己的招式。

dataContractZh: 特性操作码 PASSIVE_PREVENT_ATTACK_DAMAGE_WHILE_BENCHED（被动，amount 必须为 0）。只防止伤害，不防止招式的其它效果。
serverAuthorityZh: 与太晶规则走同一个判断（ServerMatch.benchedPreventsAttackDamage）：目标不在战斗位、并且是太晶宝可梦或带这个被动特性；特性被压制时不生效。攻击伤害与备战区伤害组件两条管线都读它。
limitations: 只写 “by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon” 的版本（只挡对手的招式）以及 “prevent all damage from and effects of attacks” 的版本不在本操作码内。
